title: Canada Goose to Announce Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results on May 14, 2026
summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026, which ended March 29, 2026, before markets open on Thursday, May 14, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, May 14, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at http://investor.canadagoose.com . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link: Canada Goose Q4 2026 Earnings Call . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call.
